description: run-04 DTB failures paired with same-case healthy Vanilla contexts

Second DTB retry repeated the truncated task arguments; compare both historical contexts under both controller variants.
Third DTB retry repeated the truncated task arguments before the later successful delegation.
DTB stopped while stating that checkout was next; Vanilla issued the same-case checkout tool call.
DTB stopped after announcing report generation; Vanilla emitted the same-case JSON/Markdown report write call.
First code-writing turn from each generation subagent; output must be inspected/applied and compiled outside this transport replay.
First code mutation turn; historical Vanilla completed with an excellent report while DTB was unqualified.
Code-writing turn covering the XML-generation regression; transport replay cannot judge XML/build correctness.
